_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 10: 2025-01-28 to 2025-03-05. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He reminds viewers of a blood red moon on 14 March, calls it a significant sign in the heavens concerning war and an escalation of war, and cites Kim Clement.
mentions.quote: on March the 14th we have a blood red moon this is a significant sign
mentions.falsify_match: A war escalation dated to or shortly after 14 March 2025.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer that no weapon prosper and everything they touch prospers, that the rest of 2025 be a time of great acceleration in which they thrive, with great promotion in jobs.
mentions.quote: the rest of 2025 that father it will be a time that we Thrive
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: private outcomes over an unnamed audience.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees a lot of sad people with no hope when he goes places, and that there is hope, a blessing and a plan with Jesus.
mentions.quote: there is a hope with Jesus
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: exhortation.

mentions.claim_text: Teaching that Paul's warning about the works of the flesh is addressed to Christians rather than sinners, since sinners are already in the flesh.
mentions.quote: he's addressing Christians right I said he's addr
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: doctrinal teaching.

mentions.claim_text: Teaching that you must yield and move your mouth by faith to pray in tongues, because he will not take your tongue over for you even though it may sound goofy.
mentions.quote: he's not going to come over and take your tongue over
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: teaching.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord showed him in 2020 that there would be a chicken shortage that would move into turkeys and then into cattle, and that it was a planned event.
mentions.quote: the Lord showed me in 2020 that there was going to be a chicken shortage
mentions.falsify_match: Successive poultry, turkey and cattle supply crises, which have partly occurred.

mentions.claim_text: He says he was shown there would not be enough turkeys for everyone at Thanksgiving one year, starting with the chickens, and points to bird flu culls and the current egg shortage.
mentions.quote: there would not be enough turkeys for everybody to have a turkey at Thanksgiving
mentions.falsify_match: A Thanksgiving with a documented national turkey shortfall.

mentions.claim_text: He explains that things look like they are happening right in front of your face but are a couple of years out, counting 2020 through to 2025 for the chicken word now appearing in the news.
mentions.quote: it looks like it's going to happen right now and it's a couple years out
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable as stated, and it is the clearest statement of why his dates run early.

mentions.claim_text: He says that at the beginning of this year he saw major strikes coming against Iran soon and a crippling of Iran's economy like never before, alongside the Italian earthquakes and Trump on protecting Israel.
mentions.quote: major strikes coming against Iran soon and that it would be uh a crippling
mentions.falsify_match: Major military strikes on Iran and a collapse of its economy.

mentions.claim_text: He explains that he showed a missile on air, that people were upset and asked him to pull it because it could put the United States in jeopardy, and that he was only trying to be real.
mentions.quote: people were so upset that I showed that missile
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an account of a moderation decision.

mentions.claim_text: He describes water coming in worse over the islands, naming St Martin, St Thomas and the Bahamas as completely covered with water, and links it to news of an asteroid dated to 2032 or 2038.
mentions.quote: the islands like uh St Martin St Thomas all those I'm talking completely covered
mentions.falsify_match: Caribbean islands inundated, whether by asteroid impact, tsunami or storm surge.

mentions.claim_text: He notes another author warning about Apophis hitting in 2029, says he does not know the date, but that in the vision it felt warmer outside when it went over the United States.
mentions.quote: warning about Aus hitting in 2029 and all these things I don't know the date
mentions.falsify_match: An Apophis impact, which current orbital data rules out for 2029.
mentions.falsify_miss: The 2029 close approach passes without impact, as astronomers expect.

mentions.claim_text: He says someone who has since died put it in April, which matches the temperature and season he felt in the vision, and compares the certainty to the New Orleans warning he was given.
mentions.quote: it was in April so it kind of goes with what I felt
mentions.falsify_match: An impact or comparable event in an April.
mentions.falsify_miss: None, though no year is fixed.

mentions.claim_text: He tells viewers to believe for an expiration date on what they are going through, including generational poverty.
mentions.quote: believe for the expiration date of your of what you're going through
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: private circumstance with a belief condition.

mentions.claim_text: He urges viewers to be the generation that says thus far and no further to sickness, disease and poverty, and to walk in abundance, healing and deliverance instead.
mentions.quote: you could be that generation that says thus far and no further
mentions.condition_text: conditioned on the hearer taking the stand
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: exhortation.

mentions.claim_text: He describes travelling to meetings in Chattanooga, Orlando and Tampa to pick up a cross pollination anointing and bring it back to his church.
mentions.quote: thank you for the provisions to go to these meetings
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: travel plans.

mentions.claim_text: He refers back to the 25th of December and the chariots of fire bringing gifts, and reports the Lord saying he is about to do something never done before on this earth with mantles of glory unlike anything seen.
mentions.quote: you're about to see mantles of the glory like you've never seen before
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: no observable criterion for mantles of glory.

mentions.claim_text: He says he has been stirred to pray for viewers' finances and for better jobs, that they be the head and not the tail, because he sees so many lacking.
mentions.quote: for you to be the head not the H and above and not beneath
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: intercession.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer that the eyes of unbelievers be enlightened against Satan's blinding, resting on the promise that a child trained up will not depart from it.
mentions.quote: Satan blinds the eyes of the unbeliever
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: intercession, and a near verbatim repeat of AWpWnczIhdQ@223.

mentions.claim_text: He says men's hearts failing them for fear at what is coming on the earth is happening now, and that fear tolerated is faith contaminated so fear has to go.
mentions.quote: fear tolerated is Faith contaminated
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a reading of present anxiety as prophecy fulfilled.

mentions.claim_text: He thanks God for angels coming out of a portal and for strong warnings given in the midnight hour through dreams and visions, and prays again over the electric grid from Miami to Los Angeles and Phoenix.
mentions.quote: if it's about the electric grid over over Miami from LA
mentions.falsify_match: A grid failure across the named metros.
mentions.falsify_miss: None, credited to prayer. Near verbatim repeat of 5CWynywOvK0@1274 from Oct 2023.

mentions.claim_text: Teaching that the body of Christ works together as hand and foot, and that the parts not seen are often the most vital.
mentions.quote: even the parts that are not seen are sometimes the most vital
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: teaching.

mentions.claim_text: The Lord tells him to get a bigger net because they are coming in hot and fast like a fastball, catch or miss, tied to the coming shaking.
mentions.quote: Brandon it's time get a bigger net you got to catch them
mentions.falsify_match: A mass influx of converts fast enough to overwhelm churches.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord told him forty one years ago there was not enough urgency in his body, asks how much more urgency is needed in 2025, and describes seeing Jesus with his hand on the doorknob looking up.
mentions.quote: his hand was on the door knob and he was looking u
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an imminence image with no date, and the same urgency was reported forty one years earlier.

mentions.claim_text: He recounts being asked when he will shift from believing a manifestation comes one day to believing for it now, since faith is the substance of things hoped for.
mentions.quote: when are you going to shift it to now
mentions.condition_text: conditioned on believing for it now rather than one day
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: teaching.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is time to believe God for the impossible and to change the stinking thinking that says you will always be at the bottom of the barrel financially.
mentions.quote: it's time to change that stinking thinking
mentions.condition_text: conditioned on changing how you think
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: exhortation.

mentions.claim_text: He tells viewers standing for unsaved loved ones not to be moved when those people act badly, even after being told they are coming home.
mentions.quote: I thought you told me they're coming home and they act that
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: contrary evidence is defined in advance as not counting.

mentions.claim_text: He acknowledges it is not always easy going through it and pushes back on the reflex of concluding you did not have enough faith after a rough night.
mentions.quote: I guess I didn't have enough Faith again no
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and notable: he explicitly rejects the not-enough-faith explanation he elsewhere relies on.

mentions.claim_text: Quoting Rick Renner, he compares asking the Holy Spirit for help to an old tea kettle that takes longer to whistle when the water is cold than when it is already hot.
mentions.quote: it's like an old tea kettle it takes a little bit sometimes
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: teaching illustration.

mentions.claim_text: Healing prayer naming constipation, liver and gallbladder problems, cancers, diabetes and high blood pressure over the audience.
mentions.quote: I call for healing and wholeness and wellness over their bodies
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable in practice: conditions common enough that any large audience supplies matches.

mentions.claim_text: He compares what is coming to 11 September 2001 changing everything and producing Homeland Security, and says the Lord spoke to him very sternly that there will be events he is not going to warn loudly about any more.
mentions.quote: there'll be events that he's not going to yell about anymore
mentions.falsify_match: An event of 9/11 scale followed by a permanent expansion of state security powers.

mentions.claim_text: He says he is a watchman rather than a prophet, that he warned about the chickens back in 2022 when people thought it was years away, that there are no eggs in the store now, and that the Lord said they will kill all the chickens soon.
mentions.quote: the Lord said they will kill all the chickens soon
mentions.falsify_match: Mass culling of poultry flocks, which has occurred at scale under bird flu.

mentions.claim_text: He urges refusing sickness and financial loss and standing up on the inside even when you cannot stand on the outside, though the waves knock you down and the car gets repossessed.
mentions.quote: I refuse to allow my body to be sick anymore
mentions.condition_text: conditioned on standing on the inside
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: exhortation.

mentions.claim_text: He says he does not consider himself a prophet in the way others are named, that he may see prophetically, but that God has always told him his role is to pray, intercede and warn, and that doing so turns things in governments.
mentions.quote: you are to pray you are to intercede and intercede and you warn my people
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and it matters for scoring: he declines the prophet label while making dated predictions.

mentions.claim_text: Teaching that if God delivered Israel from the plagues of Egypt he will deliver believers, who have a greater covenant in Christ than the Abrahamic one.
mentions.quote: if he delivered the children of Israel from the plagues of Egypt
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: teaching, and the exemption clause for the plague claims.

mentions.claim_text: He says the glory will manifest on all fronts with salvations and people waking from slumber, and finances transferring over to the church so they are ready for what is coming.
mentions.quote: finances tra coming over to the church getting ready for what's coming
mentions.falsify_match: A measurable transfer of wealth into churches ahead of a crisis.

mentions.claim_text: He says they are getting ready for 2027 and have a window to pray, that he sometimes sees things five or ten years off, and that it will start in the fall with a three month window running to springtime.
mentions.quote: it will start in the fall and by Springtime I saw a three-month window
mentions.time_phrase: starts in the fall, into spring
mentions.falsify_match: An outbreak beginning in an autumn and peaking through the following spring.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such seasonal pattern, though the year is left open.

mentions.claim_text: He says the end of February, March, April and May were highlighted as the bulk of it, with June, July and August fading out like a black crayon being faded.
mentions.quote: February March April May were highlighted for great the the the bulk of it
mentions.time_phrase: late February to May, fading June to August
mentions.falsify_match: An outbreak peaking February to May and receding over the summer.

mentions.claim_text: He describes the months running October, November, December, January and February on a calendar, but says the Lord took it and counted it backwards.
mentions.quote: the calendar started with uh the October showing like this
mentions.falsify_match: The backwards count is the whole ambiguity: it makes the sequence readable in either direction.

mentions.claim_text: He says the calendar went backwards rather than forwards, which the Lord had never done with him before and which he did not understand, then moves to communion.
mentions.quote: it went backwards and that's the way he he he showed it to me
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable as delivered: he says outright he does not understand the direction, so no year can be fixed.
